title: UFC Scoreboard Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration for the UFC fight-night Game Mode plugin

show_in_ticker.description: Show UFC fights in the scrolling ticker (off by default — this plugin is Game-Mode-only)

card_scope.description: Which fights to track as the current active fight

fight_window_hours.description: Show UFC Game Mode as available this many hours before the first fight of the card

update_interval.description: Idle ESPN refresh interval (seconds) when no fight is live

live_update_interval.description: Accelerated ESPN+Kalshi refresh interval (seconds) while a fight is live

post_fight_hold_seconds.description: Seconds to hold the just-ended fight on-screen before advancing to the next

pre_cycle_interval_seconds.description: Seconds each upcoming fight is shown before cycling to the next when no fight is live

display_timezone.description: IANA timezone for formatting fight start times in the UP NEXT caption

favorite_fighters.description: Optional list of fighter last names to favor (reserved for future auto-focus)
